t: Detect custom AI personality files (SPARKY.md etc) at wakeup and list them for awareness without overwriting
description: Some spokes have custom AI personality files (e.g., SPARKY.md for code-puppy). Wakeup should detect and surface these for awareness without modifying them.
perceive: 1. Read templates/commands/wai.md Step 1 (Load Integration File) — where AI tool detection happens. 2. Check if any spokes have non-standard .md files at root (SPARKY.md, CUSTOM-AI.md, etc.). 3. Read WAI-Spoke/WAI-File-Index.json if it exists — does it track custom files?
execute: 1. Add to wai.md Step 1: after detecting integration file, glob for *.md at project root that aren't CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md/README.md/CHANGELOG.md. 2. If found: surface in briefing under Context Health: 'Custom AI files detected: SPARKY.md (do not overwrite)'. 3. Sync wai.md to all targets.
verify: 1. Spoke with SPARKY.md at root — wakeup mentions it. 2. Spoke without custom files — no extra output. 3. Custom files are never modified by any WAI process.
acceptance_criteria: wai.md Step 1 detects non-standard *.md files at project root (excluding known files)
Detected custom AI files surfaced in Context Health section of wakeup briefing
Custom files are never modified by any WAI process
Spokes without custom files produce no extra output

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Awareness-only detection of custom AI files at wakeup
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not indexing or managing these files — just surfacing their existence
